chunks: From him, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ja'far ibn Muhammad ibn Bashshar, from Abdullah al-Dihqan, from Abd al-Hamid, from Abu Ibrahim (peace be upon him), who said:

The Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'Keep your children, your madmen, your buying, and your selling away from your mosques, and place your urinals at the doors of your mosques.'
ai.seo_question: What activities and groups should be kept away from mosques according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) emphasizes the sanctity of mosques by prohibiting disruptive elements such as children, the mentally incapacitated, and commercial transactions, while also prescribing practical hygiene measures like placing urinals at entrances. It reflects the Shia scholarly understanding of maintaining both spiritual purity and physical cleanliness in places of worship, ensuring they remain conducive to prayer and contemplation.
